title: Hot Foil vs Cold Foil for Paper Box Packaging

seo.title: Hot Foil vs Cold Foil for Paper Box Packaging

content:
This article compares two foil processes for paper packaging.

## Heated Process

This option is often used for premium cartons and brand marks. It gives a crisp metallic effect and is common in luxury paper packaging.

## Inline Process

This option is often used for labels and fast production lines. It is useful when metallic areas need to combine with printed colors.

## How to Choose

Base the choice on the material, machine, artwork, quantity and final appearance.
